en: Sepia-toned studio portrait of a seated woman in elaborate traditional dress. She wears a large headdress with braided hair, heavy necklaces and pendants, ornate earrings, and layered garments with a striped apron-like lower garment. She sits on a rustic wooden bench with plants or shrubs arranged beside her, against a painted backdrop suggesting an outdoor scene. A small circular mark with numbers appears at the lower right corner, resembling an archival or publisher stamp.
